pages.text: Hierarch Artanis waits under the dome of the mothership high in the stratosphere over the protoss base.

A blinding dash and psionic storm; he fights as a zealot, dodges and flanks. His shields come back only out of the fight — but when they are gone he kneels and bursts in a flash that throws you back (once in two minutes), his shields whole again. At 2/3 health void rays and phoenixes come in; at 1/3 a tempest and a carrier.$(br2)$(l)When beaten$() Amun's hold breaks and the hero joins you (see Amun's Hold), leaving: Artanis's Helmet, the rest of a protoss suit, 16 shards, 8 diamonds.
